subject: Fix crash in unittests introduced in previous PR (#1027)
reason: The change modifies only unit-test files (testing/expr/expr_test.cc and testing/expr/value_test.cc), switching their gtest fixtures to inherit from vmsdk::ValkeyTest to fix a crash in the project's own test harness. No runtime code of the valkey-search module changes, so the module's behavior under the fuzzer is identical at the change and its parent; a compared sequence would show no difference and no fault path is affected.
